installed_sdk_source_proof.worker_barrier: e2ee.worker serializes setKey/enable in AsyncQueue; enable echoes original message after prior queued key derivation. installed_sdk_source_proof.capture_boundary: LocalParticipant.setTrackEnabled awaits public createTracks/createScreenTracks then public publishTrack. Pinned instance wrappers fence these public SDK boundaries before/after awaits. Private SDK reconnect republish retains GCM while current MediaStreamTracks are paused.
